newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Robeco Group to launch East Europe investment fund.
newsitem.headline: Robeco Group to launch East Europe investment fund.

text.p: The Robeco group of investment funds said on Wednesday it planned to launch a Dutch fund aimed at investments in Eastern Europe.
"This area will become a cornerstone of our emerging markets investment policies," board member Jaap van Duijn told a news conference.

He said the fund would invest directly and indirectly in companies in Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic and possibly Turkey. But the Robeco group was also studying investment prospects in Romania and Bulgaria, whose economies were expected to stabilise at a later stage.
"We want to be in those markets at an early stage because that (the stabilisation) is the time when the really big profits can be made," Van Duijn said.
Robeco said it saw much better prospects for investments in emerging markets in general this year than in previous years.
"After two years of disappointing results, 1997 could well become a year during which emerging markets could show better investment results than the established markets," it said.
Emerging markets were now showing relatively attractive valuation levels and these countries were seen realising a rather strong economic growth this year, the group added.
